narrative:
## Handover Summary — Blended Workforce Planning

Human and virtual-agent capacity planned per contract and interval.

## Key Decisions
• 20 advisors moved from Kent and Bexley evenings to DWP mornings (~GBP 0.4M KPI credits avoided)
• Containment 18% → 25% on the top 40 intents (~140 FTE released to casework)
• TOIL capped at 15 hours per advisor
